list: The official 55 trophies, as listed on PlayStation Network and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026, cross-checked against TrueAchievements, GTABase and PowerPyx (via GTA-Zone). 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; the guides are this entry's own words and cite their sources. See SOURCES.md. Seven sources back this guide, all retrieved and verified on 20 November 2026; see SOURCES.md.
platinum_estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). Story about 60-80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100 hours, Strangers & Freaks and cleanup about 10 hours. One playthrough, no difficulty settings, no mission replay, free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops automatically. That means the full story, the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, and every grind in this guide. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, so treat it as a long, steady checklist rather than a hard one, and work through the roadmap in this guide phase by phase.

Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.

Free roam continues after the story, so cleanup can wait until after the credits.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist itself (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but everything you do earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx's rundown of what the checklist asks for: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, all 8 bank vaults, all 42 Top Fun drone races and all 39 gang operations. Expect about 100 hours for this part alone, and chip at it alongside the story instead of leaving it all for after the credits.

Play normally, then mop up the remainder in free roam after the credits, where you can repeat jumps and near-misses without story pressure.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. This is the hardest pure-skill trophy on the list, so treat it as a practice project: learn one range at a time, use the weapon each challenge favours, and redo a challenge until the gold time or score clicks. It never expires and there is no penalty for retrying.

The game's race list shows which you have won, so work through it methodically and the trophy pops at the twentieth distinct win.

trophies.target: 3 shops in a row, wanted level kept

The trick is keeping the wanted level alive through all three robberies, not losing the police, so do not let the stars clear between shops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max Strength for Jason and Lucia
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia; working out together trains both at once. This is a slow build rather than a single moment. Fold gym sessions into your regular play and the trophy pops when the second character's Strength tops out.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It is a running total across the whole playthrough, so it builds up on its own as you play. One warning from the guides: do not push towards the Irredeemable profile, because that change is permanent.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, so every laundering job adds up, and Yasmani pays the most, so favour his contacts when you have the choice. Keep laundering as you earn marked bills through the story and the robberies rather than saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Normal play gets you most of the way there through weapons, clothes, food and gear, so do not force it. Buy what you need, and if you are short near the end, spend the remainder on anything useful in the shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 garages for sale, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so do not wait for them. Buy garages as you can afford them through the story, since the space also helps with On the Spot and the vehicles you collect.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration, so buy garages (Little Boxes) before you start registering in bulk. Then work through ten different vehicles.
